title: Deck Brief
description: Stage 2 output: what the deck must say, before it is laid out onto slides. The narrative spine (from lib/schemas/deck_registry.json's entry for the chosen deck_type), the key messages, and per-message source references — deliberately separate from deck_plan.json so a change to the story doesn't require re-deriving it from the plan.

narrative.description: The spine, from the deck-type registry: situation-complication-resolution / pyramid / chronological.
